newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends mostly up on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends mostly up on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly higher on Monday, except for spot June, as views that prices were too low and the yen's late retreat against the dollar stimulated moderate technical buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 2.1 yen higher.
Benchmark November was ended up 1.3 yen at 137.1 yen.

The market started weaker across the board on the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar. "There was no news to effect the market except for the currency market," an analyst at a commodity broker said. "Rubber prices are likely to move within a limited range looking for direction," he said.
